summary: Log in to an Azure Container Registry through the Docker CLI. Docker must be installed on your machine. Once done, use `docker logout <registry url>` to log out. (If you only need a refresh token and do not want to install Docker, specify '-- expose-token').

parameters.name: --name
parameters.help: The name of the container registry. It should be specified in lower case. You can configure the default registry name using `az configure --defaults acr=<registry name>`.

parameters.name: --endpoint
parameters.help: Log in to a specific regional endpoint of the container registry. Specify the region name (e.g., eastus, westus2). Only applicable when regional endpoints are enabled. WARNING: Argument '--endpoint' is in preview and under development. Reference and support levels: https://aka.ms/CLI_refstatus

parameters.name: --expose-token
parameters.help: Expose refresh token instead of automatically logging in through Docker CLI.

parameters.name: --password
parameters.help: The password used to log into a container registry.

parameters.name: --resource-group
parameters.help: Name of resource group. You can configure the default group using `az configure --defaults group=<name>`.

parameters.name: --suffix
parameters.help: The tenant suffix in registry login server. You may specify '--suffix tenant' if your registry login server is in the format 'registry- tenant.azurecr.io'. Applicable if you're accessing the registry from a different subscription or you have permission to access images but not the permission to manage the registry resource.

parameters.name: --username
parameters.help: The username used to log into a container registry.

parameters.name: --acquire-policy-token
parameters.help: Acquiring an Azure Policy token automatically for this resource operation.

parameters.name: --change-reference
parameters.help: The related change reference ID for this resource operation.

parameters.name: --debug
parameters.help: Increase logging verbosity to show all debug logs.

parameters.name: --help
parameters.help: Show this help message and exit.

parameters.name: --query
parameters.help: JMESPath query string. See http://jmespath.org/ for more information and examples.

parameters.name: --subscription
parameters.help: Name or ID of subscription. You can configure the default subscription using `az account set -s NAME_OR_ID`.

parameters.name: --verbose
parameters.help: Increase logging verbosity. Use --debug for full debug logs.
